title: Review sampling
asOf: Progress read at {{time}}. Refresh for current status.
boundary: Sampling organizes reviews. Unselected and unreviewed submissions are not approved. New rework revisions enter the ordinary pending queue.
name: Batch name
perSubmitter: Round up separately for each submitter
visibleScope: Counts and sample rate cover only submissions visible to you; your own submissions are excluded.
progressBoundary: Approved and rejected count as reviewed. Superseded, unavailable and unselected items do not count as approval. Newer revisions do not change this frozen sample.
reviewUnavailable: Pending submissions are visible, but review is currently unavailable. Refresh to check access.
noReviewableItems: No items are currently reviewable in this sample. This does not mean every item is approved.
reviewSaved: The review was saved. Do not submit it again to refresh progress.
progressRefreshFailed: Progress could not be updated. Details were cleared; refresh to check current access.
savedRefreshFailed: Review saved, but progress could not be updated. Refresh this batch; do not repeat the review.
loadFailed: Cannot load batches. Refresh to check current access.
tooLarge: More than 1,000 candidate submissions. Narrow the selection.
previewFailed: Cannot preview. Check inputs, source integrity and current access.
changed: Candidates changed. Preview again before creating.
createFailed: Creation failed. Retry the same request or refresh to check access.
comparisonBoundary: Read-only comparison with the original rejected revision. Differences do not approve work or change the frozen sample.
comparisonUnavailable: Comparison unavailable. Evidence was cleared. Refresh to check source availability and current access.
answersUnchanged: Annotation results unchanged. A new revision does not prove a correction.
diffUnavailable: Difference calculation unavailable. Inspect the source snapshots.
diffLegend: − removed from original; + added in selected revision. Metadata changes are included.
comparisonNeedsRefresh: Refresh to read current revision evidence.
resultComparisonBoundary: Result identifiers and structure are included. Inspect the changed values to assess the correction.
classificationBoundary: Read-only comparison of explicit revisions from independent submitters. This does not approve, arbitrate, publish or change sampling.
classificationReadFailed: Evidence could not be read. Previous answers were cleared; retry the read to check current access.
classificationChoose: Select up to 20 revisions, one per submitter
classificationNoSources: No visible submission revisions for this task.
classificationFrozenBoundary: This signed receipt keeps exact revisions, content/configuration hashes and calculation time. Rechecking never substitutes newer revisions. It grants no access and is not a permanent audit ledger.
classificationFormula: Agreement = pairs with identical choice sets across every control / all unordered pairs. Choice order and result region IDs do not affect this metric.
classificationDisagrees: Different choice sets at this control
classificationAgrees: Identical choice sets at this control
classificationReason_insufficient_inputs: At least two independent submitters are required.
classificationReason_duplicate_submitter: Select exactly one explicit revision per submitter.
classificationReason_missing_submitter: A trusted submitter identity is missing.
classificationReason_invalid_source: Source integrity or review evidence is invalid.
classificationReason_unsupported_config: Only static global Choices linked to Text are supported in this version.
classificationReason_cancelled_or_missin: An input is cancelled or has no annotation result.
classificationReason_missing_or_malforme: Classification values are missing, malformed or outside configured labels.
classificationReason_source_unavailable: A frozen source no longer exists. No replacement was used.
classificationReason_unknown: The inputs cannot be compared under this rule.
classificationReason_missing_submission: An active participant has not submitted. The participant was not removed.
classificationReason_latest_revision_unu: The latest revision is unavailable. No older revision was substituted.
classificationReason_source_integrity_fa: The source no longer matches the frozen calculation.
batchBoundary: Find text classification disagreements in a frozen task set. This queue does not approve, arbitrate or change sampling.
batchFrozenBoundary: This persisted batch keeps its original revisions and results. New submissions require a new batch.
batchLimits: Up to 100 tasks, 20 active participants per task and 8 MiB of source snapshots. Oversized batches are rejected in full.
batchScopeFrozen: Preview scope: {{count}} visible tasks, enumerated at {{time}}. New tasks are not added automatically.
batchEmpty: No comparison batches are visible in this project.
batchNoItems: No visible tasks match this filter.
batchVisibleSubset: Counts and pages cover your visible subset. Tasks containing your own input are excluded.
batchReadFailed: The request could not be verified. Check access and limits, then retry the same scope.
batchPreviewRejected: Preview is no longer valid. Check the scope and limits, then preview again before creating a batch.
batchUnknown: Creation has no confirmed acknowledgement. Keep the original request and key to recover it.
batchSaved: Batch #{{id}} was saved. Refreshing the view does not repeat creation.
batchRecovered: Original batch #{{id}} was recovered. No duplicate was created.
arbitrationBoundary: Adopt one existing frozen revision. Original annotations, approval status and sampling stay unchanged.
arbitrationNoAssignees: No independent reviewer is available on this page.
arbitrationStartHint: Open a frozen disagreement comparison to dispatch an arbitration task.
arbitrationEmpty: No arbitration tasks in this view.
arbitrationDecision: Submission #{{source}} revision {{revision}} adopted by user #{{actor}} at {{time}}
arbitrationUnavailable: The complete frozen question or sources cannot be verified within the limits. Adoption is unavailable.
arbitrationReadFailed: This view could not be verified. Refresh the read-only view to check current access and sources.
arbitrationRejected: The command was rejected. Refresh and check the assignment, frozen inputs, version and limits before submitting again.
arbitrationUnknown: The command has no confirmed acknowledgement. Keep its original request and key.
arbitrationSaved_create: Arbitration task #{{id}} was dispatched. Refresh does not dispatch it again.
arbitrationSaved_decision: Adoption for arbitration #{{id}} was confirmed. Refresh does not repeat the decision.
arbitrationSaved_cancel: Cancellation of arbitration #{{id}} was confirmed. Refresh does not repeat cancellation.
priorityReviewerScope: Analysis tasks with your participation are excluded. Counts describe only visible submissions.
priorityBoundary: Choose an existing frozen analysis. Prioritization changes this new sample only; it grants no approval.
priorityLoadFailed: The analysis list could not be verified. Reload it to check current access.
priorityEmpty: No frozen analysis is available on this page. Create one in the classification queue first.
priorityUnknownBoundary: Unknown evidence is not low risk. Remaining places use deterministic seeded selection.
priorityUncovered: This sample does not cover every conflict. Choose 100% to review all candidates.
priorityProvenance: Selection evidence frozen from classification batch #{{id}}; not a current quality score.
priority_revision_mismatch: Unknown: revision differs from frozen analysis
priority_metric_unavailable: Unknown: frozen inputs are not comparable
priorityUnknownWrite: Creation has no confirmed acknowledgement. Keep the original request and key; refresh does not repeat creation.
prioritySaved: Batch #{{id}} was saved. Refresh reads do not create another batch.
partialReadFailed: Explanation is unavailable. Refresh the original comparison to recheck access and sources.
partialBoundary: This supplements exact agreement. It does not change arbitration, review or sampling. Unique labels do not identify a correct answer.
partialFormula: Jaccard = shared labels / union of labels. Average all participant pairs equally within each control, then average controls equally. Empty or missing answers are unavailable.
partialRule: Explanation rule {{rule}} · first explained {{time}}. This read receipt does not modify the original batch or provide permanent audit retention.
handoffBoundary: Link frozen review evidence to the existing arbitration workflow. Arbitration does not approve or alter the source review.
handoffEmpty: No visible handoffs for this frozen revision.
handoffLinkHint: Arbitration #{{id}} already covers these exact frozen inputs. Confirm the association to retain both origins.
arbitrationSaved_handoff: Handoff saved to arbitration #{{id}}. Review state is unchanged.
qualityFailed: Overview could not be verified. Recheck the same frozen batch.
qualityBoundary: This batch only. Tasks have equal weight; participant pairs have equal weight within each task. Agreement is not correctness.
qualitySourceUnavailable: Frozen sources are unavailable or invalid. Scores and annotator rows are hidden; the denominator is unchanged.
qualityNoComparable: No comparable tasks. Missing or empty inputs are not perfect agreement.
nerBoundary: Read-only comparison of explicit frozen revisions. Choose one revision per independent annotator. This does not approve, arbitrate, or change sampling.
nerFormula: Strict entity F1 = 2 × exact entity matches / (entities A + entities B). Boundaries and labels must both match. This is agreement, not correctness.
nerPairCoverage: Comparable pairs: {{comparable}} / {{total}}. No overall average is calculated.
nerUnavailable: Comparison unavailable: {{reason}}. Missing sources never shrink the input set.
nerDifference_ambiguous_overlap: Overlapping group without a unique alignment
nerReason_unsupported_config: This configuration is outside the supported NER scope
nerReason_empty_or_missing_text: The frozen text is empty or missing
nerReason_cancelled_or_missing: A submission was skipped or is missing
nerReason_missing_or_malformed: A frozen answer is missing or malformed
nerReason_missing_span_text_or_malformed: Saved entity text is missing or malformed
nerReason_invalid_span: An entity does not match the frozen text and offsets
nerReason_overlapping_or_duplicate_spans: A submission contains overlapping or duplicate entities
nerReason_insufficient_inputs: At least two independent revisions are required
nerReason_no_entities: Both sides have no entities; no score is defined
nerReason_unknown: The frozen input cannot be compared
nerFrozenScope: Frozen inputs: {{inputs}}. Pair denominator: {{total}}. No comparable count is inferred from an unavailable source.
nerQualityTitle: NER quality overview for this batch
nerQualityBoundary: Only this frozen batch and your visible tasks. Pairs are equally weighted within a task; scorable tasks are equally weighted. Both-empty pairs have no score. There is no gold answer or accuracy ranking.
nerQualitySummary: Scorable task coverage: {{task}}; pair coverage: {{pair}}; strict entity F1: {{f1}}.
nerQualityBudget: The complete visible batch exceeds the overview budget. Scores are hidden; changing pages cannot reduce the scope.
nerQualityDenied: Current authority or batch visibility cannot be verified. Overview scores are hidden.
nerQualityChanged: The frozen context changed during verification. Scores are hidden; reopen the same batch to check its context.
nerQualityUnavailable: The NER comparison service is unavailable. Overview scores are hidden; no substitute score is used.
nerBatchBoundary: Freeze the latest revision of each active assignment in an explicit task scope. Only an analysis batch is created; this does not approve, arbitrate, or change sampling.
nerBatchLimits: Choose up to 100 tasks and 20 independent participants per task. The whole batch must fit the comparison budget; reduce the task scope if it is too large.
nerReason_missing_submission: A frozen participant has no submission.
nerReason_latest_revision_unusable: A selected latest revision is unusable; older revisions are not substituted.
nerArbitrationBoundary: Adopt one whole frozen NER revision. Original submissions, F1, review and sampling stay unchanged.
nerArbitrationStartHint: Open a disagreement in a frozen NER batch to dispatch an independent reviewer.
priorityNerBoundary: Prioritize verified conflicts from matching frozen NER revisions. Missing, incomparable and unmatched inputs remain unknown; arbitration does not approve a Submission.
nerHandoffBoundary: Explicitly dispatch or link an arbitration for this selected frozen NER conflict. Arbitration does not approve or reject the source review.
nerHandoffIntegrity: This history contains frozen references only. Open the arbitration to verify current source evidence.
fieldBoundary: Read-only exact frozen revisions of static text fields. No review, arbitration or sampling changes.
fieldFormula: For each pair: raw / normalized equal fields ÷ informative fields. Both normalized-empty fields are excluded; missing fields make the whole cohort unavailable. Normalize line endings and trim outer ASCII whitespace only.
fieldReason_unsupported_config: outside supported static text field scope
fieldReason_empty_or_missing_text: source text is empty or missing
fieldReason_missing_field: at least one configured field is missing; no denominator reduction
fieldReason_source_unavailable: frozen source unavailable; all values and scores are hidden
